title: The regulations for the Passover: who may participate
description: The Lord gives Moses and Aaron the regulations for the Passover: No foreigner or uncircumcised person may eat of the lamb, but a slave who is bought and circumcised may participate. Resident aliens and hired workers shall not eat of it. The lamb must be eaten in one house; no bone shall be broken, and the whole assembly of Israel shall celebrate the Passover. When a foreigner lives among you and wishes to celebrate the Passover, all males must first be circumcised. One law applies to both the native-born and the foreigner.
